provenance.title: Curtains
provenance.covers: How wide a curtain rail is for a window, how high it hangs and how far the curtain reaches down. Rules of thumb in our own words. No open source for the numbers was found.

sources.name: Approved Document M (UK government), for reach heights only. Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. The rail reaches past the window by the overlap each side. A window narrower than the minimum gets no curtain.
